W3.notes: Positions from seven Aug 2023 Street View panos (some watermarked 2024); the x1.5 scale fits, then the chain was stretched to the wall (s = (est-5.5)*1.077) to match the Earth view (gable section s 31-52). Column positions +-1 m. Tenant churn: Pita Factory and Tokyo Smoke (2023 signs) are not on the current Google list, which shows Mom's Pan Fried Bun (#26A) and Hero Tea (unit 27) here instead, so these two boards may have changed; OSM's Super Chicken (26) and Phoenix Cannabis (27) are outdated. The vacant red-film unit and the half-installed sign next to it are probably Dine Stination and/or Hou Kee (Google). Molly Bloom's is a separate building to the east.
